note: CAP v3: parked, stalled and waiting-on-CI/review/deploy runs, queue reasons, troubled sandboxes with Repair, and the pod's own schedules with an editor

children.value_expr: Sign in to your agent runner
The pod connects to the runner with its address and the token it gave you. The token is stored sealed on the pod and never shown again.

on_click.title: Pause $item.name?
on_click.message: It won't run on its schedule until you resume it.

children.empty_text: No schedules yet. Add one below; the pod sends a run at each of its times.

children.value_expr: A cron of five fields (minute hour day month weekday), e.g. 52 3 * * * for 03:52 every day, in the time zone you give (the pod's when blank).

children.placeholder: What should Claude do each time?

on_click.title: Repair $item.name?
on_click.message: The runner sets the sandbox up again: a new agent daemon and key, the same users and work. Its runs wait until it is back.

on_click.title: Sign out of the runner?
on_click.message: The pod forgets the runner's address, token and everything it sent.

children.value_expr: Answer it in the Claude app.

on_click.title: Stop this run?
on_click.message: Claude stops where it is; its work so far stays in the sandbox.

children.value_expr: Reopens the task: a new run continues this conversation with your message.
Change what you need; a blank field keeps its value.

on_click.title: Delete ${agents://schedules/$route.name#name}?
on_click.message: It won't run again. Runs it already started go on.
